teaser.en: A rough-leaved bush with small sweet-scented flowers and orange berries, sharing its Digo name with three other plants.
teaser.sw: Kichaka chenye majani makwaruzu, maua madogo yenye harufu nzuri na matunda ya rangi ya chungwa, kinachoshiriki jina lake la Kidigo na mimea mingine mitatu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chenye makodza ganayokaraza, maruwa madide ga arufu nono na matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa; dzinare ra Chidigo nkuhumirwa piya kpwa mimea yanjina mihahu.

summary.en: This nchikoma is Ehretia amoena, a deciduous shrub or small tree of dry bush with rough leaves and small orange to red fruits. The Digo use the same name for three other species.
summary.sw: Nchikoma huu ni Ehretia amoena, kichaka au mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani, wa vichaka vikavu, wenye majani makwaruzu na matunda madogo ya rangi ya chungwa hadi nyekundu. Wadigo hutumia jina hilohilo kwa spishi nyingine tatu.
summary.dg: *Nchikoma* uhu ni *Ehretia amoena*, chitsaka au muhi mdide wa weruni kukavu ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wenye makodza ganayokaraza na matunda madide ga rangi ya chungbwa hadi ya kundu. Adigo anahumira dzina hiri piya kpwa aina zanjina zihahu.

about.en:
*Ehretia amoena* is a shrub or small tree, usually a few metres tall, often losing its leaves in the dry season. The leaves are oval and rough, sometimes hairy, and the small white to pale mauve flowers come in loose clusters and are sweetly scented.

The fruits are small round berries that ripen orange to red.
about.sw:
*Ehretia amoena* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa mita chache, mara nyingi hupukutisha majani wakati wa kiangazi. Majani ni ya umbo la yai na makwaruzu, wakati mwingine yenye manyoya, na maua madogo meupe hadi ya zambarau hafifu huja kwa mafungu yaliyolegea na yana harufu nzuri.

Matunda ni beri ndogo za mviringo zinazoiva na kuwa za rangi ya chungwa hadi nyekundu.
about.dg:
*Ehretia amoena* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, kpwa kawaida wa urefu wa mita chache, na mara nyinji makodzage nkugbwa wakati wa kazikazi. Makodza ni ga umbo ra tumbi na ganakaraza, wakati wanjina gana nyere, na maruwa madide, mereru hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu, ganamera phamwenga ganayoenea-enea na gana arufu nono.

Matunda ni madide ga mviringo, na gachiivwa ganakala ga rangi ya chungbwa hadi ya kundu.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, wooded grassland and thicket across eastern and southern Africa. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, nyika zenye miti na vichaka vizito kote mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kukavu, phatu pha nyasi phenye mihi na vitsakani, Afrika Mashariki na Afrika ya Kusini. Pakia waandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: No Digo use is recorded. Elsewhere in eastern and southern Africa the small fruits are eaten, and the roots and bark are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya Kidigo yaliyoripotiwa. Kwingineko mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika, matunda yake madogo huliwa, na mizizi na gome hutumika katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo ganayoandikpwa. Phatu phanjina pha Afrika Mashariki na Afrika ya Kusini, matunda madide nkuriwa, na mizi na gopha nkuhumirwa dza muhaso wa chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records *nchikoma* for this plant, and the same name for *Ehretia bakeri*, *Diphasia* sp. A and *Vepris eugeniifolia*. The meaning of the name is not explained, and how speakers tell the four apart is not recorded. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchikoma* kwa mmea huu, na jina hilohilo kwa *Ehretia bakeri*, *Diphasia* sp. A na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. Maana ya jina haielezwi, na jinsi wazungumzaji wanavyoitofautisha mimea hii minne haijaripotiwa. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nchikoma* kpwa mmea uhu, na dzina hiri piya kpwa *Ehretia bakeri*, *Diphasia* sp. A na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. Mana ya dzina taielezwa, na Pakia kaandika atu anavyomanya chila mwenga kahi ya mimea hino mine. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.
